SELECT T31.BASE_RULE_ID, T31.RATE, T31.RATE_TYPE, T31.COEFFICIENT, T31.SPREAD_RATE, T31.EFF_DATE, T31.RATE INT_RATE, T31.INDEX_ID, T31.INDEX_SOURCE INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T31 WHERE T31.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T31.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType01}
AND T31.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
UNION SELECT T1.BASE_RULE_ID, T1.RATE, T1.RATE_TYPE, T1.COEFFICIENT, T1.SPREAD_RATE, T1.EFF_DATE, T5.INT_RATE, T1.INDEX_ID, '' INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.INT_RATE_ID ) T3, FIN_PRODUCT T4, MST_INT_RATE_INFO T5 WHERE T1.EFF_DATE = T4.VDATE AND T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02}
AND T1.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
AND T1.INDEX_SOURCE in('03','04') AND T5.INT_RATE_ID = T1.INDEX_ID AND T5.INT_RATE_ID = T3.INT_RATE_ID AND T5.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE
UNION SELECT T6.BASE_RULE_ID, T6.RATE, T6.RATE_TYPE, T6.COEFFICIENT, T6.SPREAD_RATE, T6.EFF_DATE, T12.INT_RATE, T6.INDEX_ID, T6.INDEX_SOURCE INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T6, ( SELECT max( T7.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T7.BASE_RULE_ID FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T7 WHERE T7.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T7.BASE_RULE_ID ) T8, FIN_PRODUCT T9, FIN_OPEN_RULE T10, FIN_CASH_INFO T11, MST_INT_RATE_INFO T12, ( SELECT max( T13.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T13.INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T13 WHERE T13.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T13.INT_RATE_ID ) T14 WHERE T6.BASE_RULE_ID = T8.BASE_RULE_ID AND T6.EFF_DATE = T8.EFF_DATE AND T6.FINPROD_ID = T9.FINPROD_ID AND T6.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02}
AND T6.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
AND T6.INDEX_SOURCE in('03','04') AND T9.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T11.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T10.CASH_ID = T11.CASH_ID AND T10.OPEN_MODE = #{openCycle02} AND T11.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND T11.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashTypeC01} AND T12.INT_RATE_ID = T6.INDEX_ID AND T12.INT_RATE_ID = T14.INT_RATE_ID AND T12.EFF_DATE = T14.EFF_DATE
UNION SELECT T15.BASE_RULE_ID, T15.RATE, T15.RATE_TYPE, T15.COEFFICIENT, T15.SPREAD_RATE, T15.EFF_DATE, T21.INT_RATE, T15.INDEX_ID, T15.INDEX_SOURCE INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T15, ( SELECT max( T16.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T16.BASE_RULE_ID FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T16 WHERE T16.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T16.BASE_RULE_ID ) T17, FIN_PRODUCT T18, FIN_OPEN_RULE T19, FIN_CASH_INFO T20, MST_INT_RATE_INFO T21 WHERE T15.BASE_RULE_ID = T17.BASE_RULE_ID AND T15.EFF_DATE = T17.EFF_DATE AND T15.FINPROD_ID = T18.FINPROD_ID AND T15.RESET_TYPE = #{resetType03} AND T15.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02}
AND T15.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
AND T15.INDEX_SOURCE in('03','04') AND T18.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T20.FINPROD_ID = T15.FINPROD_ID AND T20.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND T21.INT_RATE_ID = T15.INDEX_ID AND T20.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashTypeC01} AND T21.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
UNION SELECT T22.BASE_RULE_ID, T22.RATE, T22.RATE_TYPE, T22.COEFFICIENT, T22.SPREAD_RATE, T22.EFF_DATE, T28.INT_RATE, T22.INDEX_ID, T22.INDEX_SOURCE INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T22, ( SELECT max( T23.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T23.BASE_RULE_ID FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T23 WHERE T23.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T23.BASE_RULE_ID ) T24, FIN_PRODUCT T25, FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE T26, FIN_CASH_INFO T27, MST_INT_RATE_INFO T28, ( SELECT max( T29.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T29.INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T29 WHERE T29.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T29.INT_RATE_ID ) T30 WHERE T22.BASE_RULE_ID = T24.BASE_RULE_ID AND T22.EFF_DATE = T24.EFF_DATE AND T22.FINPROD_ID = T25.FINPROD_ID AND T22.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02} AND T22.INDEX_SOURCE in('03','04') AND T25.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T22.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
AND T27.FINPROD_ID = T22.FINPROD_ID AND T27.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND T27.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashTypeC04} AND T26.CASH_ID = T27.CASH_ID AND ((T22.RESET_TYPE = #{resetType01} AND T26.ACCR_STR_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR (T22.RESET_TYPE = #{resetType02} AND T26.ACCR_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND T28.INT_RATE_ID = T22.INDEX_ID AND T28.INT_RATE_ID = T30.INT_RATE_ID AND T28.EFF_DATE = T30.EFF_DATE
UNION SELECT T31.BASE_RULE_ID, T31.RATE, T31.RATE_TYPE, T31.COEFFICIENT, T31.SPREAD_RATE, T31.EFF_DATE, T35.INT_RATE, T31.INDEX_ID, T31.INDEX_SOURCE INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T31, ( SELECT max( T32.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T32.BASE_RULE_ID FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T32 WHERE T32.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T32.BASE_RULE_ID ) T33, FIN_PRODUCT T34, MST_INT_RATE_INFO T35, ( SELECT max( T36.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T36.INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T36 WHERE T36.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T36.INT_RATE_ID ) T37 WHERE T31.BASE_RULE_ID = T33.BASE_RULE_ID AND T31.EFF_DATE = T33.EFF_DATE AND T31.FINPROD_ID = T34.FINPROD_ID AND T31.RESET_TYPE = #{resetType02}
AND T31.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
AND T31.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02} AND T31.INDEX_SOURCE in('03','04') AND T34.MDATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T35.INT_RATE_ID = T31.INDEX_ID AND T35.INT_RATE_ID = T37.INT_RATE_ID AND T35.EFF_DATE = T37.EFF_DATE
UNION SELECT T1.BASE_RULE_ID, T1.RATE, T1.RATE_TYPE, T1.COEFFICIENT, T1.SPREAD_RATE, T1.EFF_DATE, 0 INT_RATE, T1.INDEX_ID, T1.INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.BASE_RULE_ID FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.BASE_RULE_ID ) T3, FIN_PRODUCT T4 WHERE T1.BASE_RULE_ID = T3.BASE_RULE_ID AND T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE AND T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T1.BASE_RULE_TYPE in (#{rateType03},#{BASE_RULE_TYPE_03})
AND T1.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02} AND T1.INDEX_SOURCE = #{benchMarkType05} AND T4.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT T1.BASE_RULE_ID, T1.RATE, T1.RATE_TYPE, T1.COEFFICIENT, T1.SPREAD_RATE, T1.EFF_DATE, T1.INDEX_SOURCE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.BASE_RULE_ID FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.BASE_RULE_ID ) T3, FIN_PRODUCT T4, WHERE T1.BASE_RULE_ID = T3.BASE_RULE_ID AND T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE AND T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.RATE_TYPE = #{rateType02} AND T1.INDEX_SOURCE = #{benchMarkType05} AND T4.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT INDEX_ID, COMPONENT_ID, COMPONENT_TYPE, WEIGHT FROM MST_INDEX_COMPONENT WHERE INDEX_ID = #{indexId}

SELECT T1.INT_RATE_ID INT_RATE_ID, T1.INT_RATE_TYPE INT_RATE_TYPE, T1.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, T1.RELAESE_DATE RELAESE_DATE, T1.INT_RATE INT_RATE, T1.CCY CCY, T1.INPUT_TYPE INPUT_TYPE FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.INT_RATE_ID ) T3 WHERE T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE AND T1.INT_RATE_ID = T3.INT_RATE_ID AND T1.INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId}

SELECT max( T1.OPEN_VDATE ) OPEN_VDATE FROM FIN_OPEN_PLAN T1,FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T2 where T1.OPEN_TYPE IN ( '01', '03' ) AND T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.BASE_RULE_ID = #{bastRuleId} AND T1.OPEN_VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT VDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T2 WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.BASE_RULE_ID = #{bastRuleId} AND T2.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.MARKET_ID FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.MARKET_ID ) T3 WHERE T1.MARKET_ID = #{componentId} AND T1.MARKET_ID = T3.MARKET_ID AND T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE

SELECT P_CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.MARKET_ID FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.MARKET_ID ) T3 WHERE T1.MARKET_ID = #{componentId} AND T1.MARKET_ID = T3.MARKET_ID AND T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE
